goal: Independently verify the cross-app redundancy reduction (Tier 1 + Tier 2 across DUEL, FREE-STACK, DASHBOARD) on branch claude/blissful-ramanujan-tcniuq @ 0b0d642: re-run every gate, scrutinize duelRedundancy.test.tsx per .claude/rules/testing.md (prove fail-first), verify shared-component blast radius (DuelStackShell section + ClimbControlsGuide collapsible), confirm the frozen climbFeelSurfaces contract is untouched, and rule out behavior/data regressions.
summary: All 7 gates re-run independently and green. app lint clean, typecheck clean, test 802 passed / 91 files (+4 from duelRedundancy.test.tsx, 0 fail — matches the SE baseline), build compiles. Route rendering modes UNCHANGED: /duel, /duel/chips, /daily, /dashboard stay ○ (Static); /play, /climb stay ƒ (Dynamic) — confirmed from the next build route table. Orchestrator typecheck clean + 58 pass. pack-hygiene 0 violations. duelRedundancy.test.tsx renders the REAL components (ChipDuelLobby, DuelHome) via renderToStaticMarkup and asserts against the rendered DOM tree — no source-text greps, no re-implemented production logic. Proved fail-first on BOTH highest-blast-radius guards: (a) flipping DuelStackShell section from 'chips' to 'play' turns a NavTab active (aria-selected="true") and turns the 'neither tab active' test RED; (b) restoring 'Buy chips' + 'Claim your free daily chips' to the /duel chips teaser tier turns the 'lean teaser' test RED. The negative guards are non-vacuous: NavTab emits aria-selected={active} (false when inactive, true when active), so not.toContain('aria-selected="true"') genuinely distinguishes state, not a rename. Shared blast radius clean: all 3 DuelStackShell callers correct (leaderboard/page.tsx section='leaderboard', ChipDuelLobby section='chips', DuelHome section='play'); the new 'chips' value yields inactive/inactive with no branch added. ClimbControlsGuide overlay usage in ClimbScene is UNCHANGED (variant='overlay', not collapsed); only PlayShell + DailyShell pass collapsible; default card DOM is byte-identical (collapsible defaults false) so the two power-up tests still pass. Frozen contract app/tests/components/climbFeelSurfaces.test.tsx is UNMODIFIED (empty git diff 7d35c22..0b0d642) and passing; ClimbPanelIntro.tsx is also unchanged in the diff — the About-uniqueness edit was made in play/page.tsx's PlayIntro as claimed. No new endpoint/fetch/route handler added; ChipDuelLobby claim/tier-picker/matchmaking logic fully preserved (moved into the shell's children); no orphaned imports (lint --max-warnings=0 green); compliance lines ('18+ · stake chips', 'Chips have no cash value…') and sr-only/aria-live intact in rendered DOM; DuelResult's single foot-of-card '…to save your record.' anon ask remains (now unconditional on all anon states). Reverted the build's next-env.d.ts churn; working tree is clean.

findings.title: Three deliberate SE skips reviewed — none is a defect

Flagging (2) and (3) to reviewer only as design-taste calls, not blockers.

learnings.insight: duelRedundancy.test.tsx's 'neither tab active' guards are non-vacuous because NavTab renders aria-selected={active} and aria-current={active?'page':undefined}. Verified fail-first: DuelStackShell section='play' on the chips lobby makes the Play NavTab emit aria-selected="true" and the test goes red. The chips-teaser guard also goes red when Buy chips/Claim are restored.
learnings.action: When a shared shell gains a neutral enum member, assert the neutral state renders inactive against the component's real active-state attribute (aria-selected/aria-current), not against a class string — and prove it by flipping the member.
